scope: Proposition 4.5 (Arithmetic constraints on the corner) of the manuscript “The arithmetic category and stable recovery of lattice factors” (preprints/The-arithmetic-category-and-stable-recovery-of-lattice-factors-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5a2107e608fdff7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the corner in Lemma 4.4, the group Λ is countably infinite and ICC. There are finite-index subgroups A ≤ Γ, B ≤ Λ, an actual group isomorphism δ : A → B, and a finite-dimensional projective representation with multiplier µ|A/δ∗(ω|B).
